# Summit Wealth Partners, LLC

> > A comprehensive wealth management firm with 40+ years of experience providing fiduciary financial planning, investment management, tax strategy, and estate planning services.

Summit Wealth Partners, LLC is a full-service financial advisory firm serving clients across Florida and Michigan with a team of CFP® professionals and specialized advisors. The firm emphasizes fiduciary responsibility, comprehensive financial planning, and personalized wealth management for individuals and business owners.

## Key Topics

- Wealth Management
- Financial Planning
- Retirement Planning
- Investment Management
- Estate Planning
- Tax Planning
- CFP® Certified Advisors
- Fiduciary Services
- 401(k) Planning
- Business Owners
- Client Onboarding
- ERISA Compliance
- Financial Insights
- Comprehensive Advice
- Team Leadership
